title: Literal PowerShell patterns for bounded ripgrep inspection
failure_signature: A double-quoted regular expression containing nested JSON quote syntax caused a PowerShell parser failure before ripgrep ran.
trigger_preconditions: regular expression with quote-like JSON syntax
multiple patterns embedded in one shell string
candidate_workaround: Use a literal single-quoted ripgrep pattern and one bounded target file per structural inspection.
recurrence_guard: Keep regular expressions literal in PowerShell and avoid nested JSON quotation in composite commands.
rollback: Retain the parse failure, make no file change, and retry the read-only query with literal quoting.
scope_boundary: Shell-query construction only; not general proof of command safety or validation completeness.
